purpose: Define explicit memory invalidation, forgetting, expiry and replacement while preserving governed audit/provenance where required.

owns: Memory Forget, Expiry and Supersession semantics

topics.name: Memory Forget, Expiry and Supersession
topics.purpose: Define explicit memory invalidation, forgetting, expiry and replacement while preserving governed audit/provenance where required.

semantics.supersession_rule: Replacement/newer evidence explicitly references superseded record where appropriate.
semantics.forget_rule: Forgotten record is excluded from future context/retrieval according to policy.
semantics.audit_rule: Minimal governed lifecycle evidence may remain without reinjecting forgotten content.
semantics.authority_rule: Forgetting memory does not alter unrelated canonical identity or Merit history.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: forgotten text remains in model context
